periodSource: finite medianMidi, otherwise finite midi; candidate tracker only; no expected-note or r2-derived pitch
missingPitchBehavior: null with missing-pitch reason; null is never MIDI zero
energyWindow: clamped sample-squared prefix sum; [a,b) as in designer probe
zeroEnergyBehavior: matches probe: 0 >= 2*0; resulting boundary time must be held, not agreed
minimumScanStart: max(search lower bound, tStar minus period)
crossingScanEnd: tStar plus period, inclusive; any resulting time near/outside search end is held
agreementComparison: compare raw r2 time to knee time minus scheme correction; equality at threshold is accepted
schemeSelection: external benchmark decision; no scheme selected here
stateTime: raw r2 for agree; no inferred or grid-derived time for hold or unmeasured
r2Uncertain: metadata only; does not control state
boundaryChecks: both raw estimator times against their own search bounds; distance <= 10 ms is held
nullClassification: missing pitch/range first; explicit pitch-change-only evidence second; otherwise energy-rise-unresolved
riseRatioProvenance: designer choice, not a literature-validated threshold
independenceLimit: knee does not read r2, but shares PCM, candidate rhoTime and tracked pitch; agreement is not truth
